title: 云海仙踪 更隔蓬山一万重 第一百二十四章 青帝云海仙踪 更隔蓬山一万重 第一百二十三章 八歧
slug: 云海仙踪更隔蓬山一万重
content_zh:
“轰”地一声巨响，远处海面惊涛狂涌，冲起百余丈高的漩涡。霎时间天昏地暗，星月全被滚滚翻涌的乌云遮住了，闪电纵横飞舞。
接着又是一阵狂雷怒爆似的咆哮，一道刺目的光芒从漩涡夭矫飞起，直破苍穹。雷声轰鸣。
许宣、小青心中“咯噔”一跳，呼吸停窒。众人满脸惊骇地仰望着满天云雾中穿梭闪耀的鳞光，须眉皆碧，全都说不出话来了。
青龙
时隔一月，终于又见到了这势可毁天灭地的恐怖巨兽
青龙在空中张牙舞爪地咆哮了片刻，那只血红的凶睛狂怒地扫望下方，似乎在寻找什么，突然甩头抛尾，飞旋着朝“天漏山”俯冲而下。
许宣大凛，难道这孽畜竟是冲着他们来的？念头未已，飓风呼啸，“轰隆”连震，山顶的雪浪顿时腾空炸涌。
他脚下一空，险些趔趄滑落。回头再看时，那座高近百丈的冰峰竟已碎如齑粉，沿着四周峭壁、冰川滚滚崩塌。
惊啼兽吼此起彼伏，不计其数的禽鸟从下方莽莽苍苍的森林里冲天掠起，四散飞逃。那成千上万、包围在裂壑上空的“三十三山”飞骑也纷纷如潮水退散。
反倒是盘旋在山顶的卡米、风青玄等人骇得肝胆尽寒，全身冻僵了似的一动不动。
许宣二人虽曾与青龙惊心动魄地贴身激斗，但眼看那狰狞的青碧龙头卷引着滚滚狂飙，狂吼着朝他们极速逼近，仍不免怖意激生，心萌退意。小青叫道：“快走”猛地抓住许宣的手，不顾一切地朝下疾冲。
“抓住彼等莫让彼等跑了”卡米等人这才如梦初醒，骑着那惊吼的龙鹫，交错飞舞，朝两人包抄追来。
“轰”“轰”在头顶青龙气旋的碾压下，冰壁接连迸裂，雪崩滚滚，冰川更是大片大片地炸断滑落，带着檬檬白气，隆隆不绝地冲撞崩泻，形成了壮观无比的“冰瀑布”。
许宣、小青大叫着腾空跃起，堪堪抢在“冰瀑”崩落前冲出了冰崖。追在身后的两个飞骑避之不及，被“冰瀑”轰然砸中，登时惨叫着急坠而下，卷没在茫茫雪浪之中。
在这恐怖而突然的自然伟力面前，凡人之力显得如此微渺，不堪一击。卡米、风青玄等人虽各怀神通，此时也只能骑鸟左冲右突，上格下挡，惊险万状地在雪崩冰瀑中逃窜，转眼之间又有几人惨叫坠落。
小青御风之术原就极为高明，经过这几个月的修炼，真暴涨，此时拉着许宣乘风飞舞，更加随心所欲。衣裳猎猎，很快便冲出了滚滚雪雾，朝着下方的裂壑极速俯冲。
青龙咆哮声越来越近，震耳欲聋。一团团烈火呼啸着从左右飞过，撞入下方的莽苍森林，烈焰冲舞。两人不敢后看，全速疾冲，只盼能抢在那孽畜抵达之前穿入裂壑。
然而那凶兽速度之快，远远超过了他们的想象。头顶突然狂风怒卷，压得他们朝下一沉，凌空翻旋。
还不等稳住身形，眼前鳞光乱舞，青龙已狂吼着从天而降，越过前方，雷霆万钧地撞向下方的山林……
“轰——隆——隆”

天地狂震，许宣眼前一黑，顿时被炸涌的气浪撞得倒冲起三丈余高，腥甜翻涌。定睛再看时，下方那莽苍森林已变成了燎原火海，青龙半身卡在裂壑之中，也似是被什么黏住了，巨尾乱舞，怒吼如雷。
闪电飞窜，天地陡亮。盘旋在裂壑上空的“三十三山”飞骑们发出雷鸣般的欢呼，叫道：“青帝陛下算无遗策，攻无不克”
许宣心中一震，这才明白青龙不是为了自己而来的，它的目标乃是蜗藏在裂壑深谷中的蛇族而三十三山似乎也早有准备，不知预先在裂壑中作了什么手脚，竟让青龙卡困其中，怎么也挣脱不出。
又听号角长吹，鼓乐大作，有人尖声长呼：“青帝驾到”
“当”金锣震响，漫天突然冲起无数条红线，“轰轰”怒爆，绽放出千朵万朵姹紫嫣红的烟花，此起彼伏，缤纷乱舞。
content_en:
There was a loud "boom", and the distant sea surged wildly, creating a whirlpool more than a hundred feet high. Suddenly the sky was dark and the earth was dark, the stars and moon were all covered by rolling dark clouds, and lightning was flying horizontally.
Then there was another burst of thunderous roar, and a dazzling light flew up from the whirlpool and broke through the sky. Thunder roared.
Xu Xuan and Xiao Qing's hearts skipped a beat and their breathing stopped. Everyone looked up at the shining scales in the clouds and mist in the sky with horrified faces, and they were all speechless.
Qinglong
After a month, I finally saw this terrifying beast that could destroy the world.
The green dragon roared in the air for a moment with its fangs and claws. Its blood-red fierce eyes glanced down furiously, as if looking for something. Then it suddenly swung its head and tail, spinning and swooping down towards "Tianluo Mountain".
Xu Xuan was shocked, could it be that this evil beast is actually coming for them? Before I could finish the thought, the hurricane roared, "booms" and earthquakes occurred, and the snow waves on the top of the mountain suddenly jumped into the sky and exploded.
His feet were empty and he almost stumbled. When I looked back, I saw that the nearly 100-foot-tall ice peak had broken into pieces and collapsed along the surrounding cliffs and glaciers.
The screams and roars of beasts came one after another, and countless birds soared into the sky from the vast forest below and fled in all directions. The tens of thousands of "Thirty-Three Mountains" flying riders surrounding the rift also retreated like a tide.
On the contrary, Kami, Feng Qingxuan and others who were hovering on the top of the mountain were so frightened that their livers and gallbladders went cold, and their whole bodies seemed to be frozen and motionless.
Although Xu and Xuan had a thrilling close fight with the green dragon, seeing the ferocious green dragon's head curling up and roaring towards them at high speed, they still couldn't help but feel fear and want to retreat. Xiao Qing shouted: "Go quickly" and grabbed Xu Xuan's hand, rushing down desperately.
"Catch them and don't let them run away." Kami and the others just woke up from a dream, riding on the roaring dragon vultures, flying in staggered directions, chasing the two of them outflanked.
"Boom" "Boom" Under the crushing force of the Qinglong cyclone overhead, the ice walls burst one after another, avalanches rolled, and large glaciers exploded and slid down. With lemon-white gas, they rumbled and collapsed, forming a spectacular "ice waterfall".
Xu Xuan and Xiao Qing shouted and jumped into the air, rushing out of the ice cliff before the "ice waterfall" collapsed. The two flying cavalry chasing behind them couldn't avoid it and were hit by the "ice waterfall". They screamed and fell sharply down, and were swept up in the vast snow waves.
In the face of this terrifying and sudden power of nature, the power of mortals seems so insignificant and vulnerable. Although Kami, Feng Qingxuan and others had their own magical powers, they could only ride birds and rush left and right, blocking up and down, and fled in the avalanche and icefall in a thrilling way. In the blink of an eye, several people fell screaming.
Xiaoqing's ability to control the wind was originally very good. After these few months of practice, his skills have improved dramatically. Now he is pulling Xu Xuan to fly in the wind, and he can do whatever he wants. Yi Shangxun soon rushed out of the billowing snow mist and dived at high speed towards the ravine below.
The green dragon's roar was getting closer and closer, deafening. Balls of flames roared past from left and right, crashing into the vast forest below, and the flames danced. The two of them didn't dare to look back and rushed at full speed, hoping to get through the ravine before the evil beast arrived.
However, the speed of the ferocious beast far exceeded their imagination. A sudden strong wind blew above their heads, causing them to sink and spin in the air.
Before he could stabilize his body, the scales were dancing in front of his eyes, and the green dragon roared down from the sky, crossed the front, and crashed into the mountains and forests below with thunderous force...
"Boom - boom - boom"
The sky and the earth shook violently, Xu Xuan's vision went dark, and he was suddenly hit by the blast of air and was thrown back more than three feet high, with a fishy and sweet surge. When he looked again, the vast forest below had turned into a prairie fire. Half of the green dragon's body was stuck in the crack, as if it was stuck by something. Its giant tail danced wildly and roared like thunder.
Lightning flashed, and the sky and the earth suddenly became bright. The "Thirty-Three Mountains" flying riders hovering over the rift let out thunderous cheers.Hu, shouting: "His Majesty the Qing Emperor has no plans left, and he can't defeat any attack."
许宣心中一震，这才明白青龙不是为了自己而来的，它的目标乃是蜗藏在裂壑深谷中的蛇族而三十三山似乎也早有准备，不知预先在裂壑中作了什么手脚，竟让青龙卡困其中，怎么也挣脱不出。
Then I heard the horns blowing and the drums blaring loudly, and someone screamed loudly: "The Qing Emperor is here!"
